name: Failover across regions (high level)
description: East's scheme pool is exhausted, so the east Rack forwards to its peer region over the Snake; west routes by the same rule and the response returns to east, which redeems the ticket it parked when it forwarded.

transitions.description: Terminal submits a 0100 to the east Rack
East destinations exhausted: forward to the peer region
West routes by BIN and submits to scheme A
Finished response returns to the origin Rack
